test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which water body is adjacent to the Atlantic Ocean, located in the southeast of the Gulf of Mexico?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Caribbean Sea**__.

__
 
• The Gulf of Mexico is connected to the **Caribbean Sea** via the Yucatán Channel and with the Atlantic Ocean through the Straits of Florida.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Gulf of Mexico borders the southeastern coast of** North America**. 
 
• It is connected to the **Atlantic Ocean** by the Straits of Florida, running between the peninsula of Florida and the island of Cuba, and to the** Caribbean Sea** by the Yucatán Channel, which runs between the Yucatán Peninsula and Cuba.
 
• Both of these channels are about **100 miles** (160 km) wide. 
 
• The gulf’s greatest east-west and north-south extents are approximately** 1,100 and 800 miles** (1,800 and 1,300 km), respectively, and it covers an area of some **600,000 square miles **(1,550,000 square km). 
 
• To the northwest, north, and northeast it is bounded by the southern coast of the **United States**, while to the west, south, and southeast it is bounded by the east coast of **Mexico**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea28c00ee10e490985db5374f1e2236971658022fe6afa67589e6935ac47f462.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Caribbean Sea**, the suboceanic basin of the western Atlantic Ocean, lying **between latitudes 9° and 22° N and longitudes 89° and 60° W**. It is approximately 1,063,000 square miles (2,753,000 square km) in extent.
 
• **The Arabian Sea is**, the Northwestern part of the Indian Ocean, lying **between India and the Arabian Peninsula**. It has an area of about 1,491,000 sq miles (3,862,000 sq km) and an average depth of 8,970 feet (2,734 m).
 
• The **Baltic Sea** is surrounded by nine countries: **Denmark, Germany, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Russia, Finland and Sweden**. 
 
• The **Caspian Sea** is the world's largest inland body of water, often described as the world's largest lake or a full-fledged sea
